messages:
Emma: AM async — quick standup for the account pulse. What I did: sent updated SSO/KMS answers to MacroHealth, demo scheduled for Wed 11am. Blockers: waiting on security to confirm KMS keywrap details for the Dedicated pilot. Today: follow up with Sec, prep demo runbook.

Kai: FYI, Pipeline: two mid-market deals moved to legal yesterday, one new POC (FinNova) — flagged FinNova for enterprise security review (they want on-prem timeline).

Jonah: Blocker on the KMS front — need clarity if customer requires HSM-backed keys or Cloud KMS with CMEK. Security asked for network diagrams and encrypted-at-rest proof. @Priya can you pull the network diagram from the intake ticket?

Priya: On it — grabbing diagrams and the intake notes now, will paste to the ticket. Also asking legal for the required contract language re: key custody.

Emma: Thanks @Priya. Link to intake + diagrams: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INTAKE-789 (see attachments, diagrams v2.pdf).

Alex: Quick ops note: PR #432 (dedicated-deploy docs) needs one more review — tagging @Mia for UX wording and @eng-oncall for deployment steps. Small change: clarify `autoscale.burst_capacity` default.

Mia: I can review PR #432 after lunch. Also can join the demo dry-run if someone wants a walkthrough — free 10:30–11:00.

eng-oncall: Noted on `autoscale.burst_capacity` — make sure the fallback policy CLI snippet is included:
```
redwood rollout set --policy fallback=compatible-variant --timeout 30s
```
I'll validate the deployment runbook once PR is updated.

Jonah: Sec asked for evidence of encryption in transit for streaming RPCs — logging snippets will do. Adding an example log and the minimal curl check: `curl -v https://api.redwood.dev/health --cert client.pem`

sec-bot: Heads-up: for enterprise deals we need completed SOC2 checklist + encryption proof before pilot kickoff. I attached the checklist to the intake ticket and flagged compliance owner. :warning:

Emma: Action items summary: 1) @Priya attach diagrams + contract ask (in progress). 2) @Alex update PR #432 with CLI snippet (ETA 2pm). 3) @Mia review PR and join dry-run (10:30). 4) @eng-oncall validate runbook after PR merge. 5) Sec team to confirm KMS/HSM requirement — @sec-bot please confirm if CMEK is acceptable or HSM mandatory for this account.

Kai: Sounds good. I'll nudge FinNova on timeline and ask product to list minimum on-prem requirements.

Mia: Will post review comments in the PR shortly. :thumbsup:

Emma: Thanks team — will update the deal thread after sec confirmation. Ping me for any blockers.
